prompt:
src/orderkit.mjs is a single file of about 700 lines that holds four separate concerns, and it has become hard to work in. Split it into four modules under src/ without changing any behavior:

1. src/money.mjs: configure, getSettings, resetSettings, currencyInfo, roundValue, toCents, fromCents, addMoney, subtractMoney, multiplyMoney, sumMoney, compareMoney, allocateCents, formatMoney, parseMoney, maxMoney, minMoney.
2. src/validate.mjs: ValidationError, validateSku, validateEmail, validateLine, validateAddress, validateOrder, assertValidOrder, normalizeOrder, supportedRegions, partitionOrders.
3. src/pricing.mjs: TAX_RATES, taxRateFor, taxCacheSize, clearTaxCache, registerCoupon, getCoupon, clearCoupons, redeemCoupon, lineSubtotal, discountAmount, shippingCost, allocateDiscount, priceOrder, checkoutOrder, resetAll.
4. src/report.mjs: renderTable, formatReceipt, toCsv, summarizeOrders, groupByRegion, topSkus, dailyReport.

Rules:
- Each of those names must be exported from the module listed for it, and defined only there. The four modules may import from each other only like this: money.mjs imports nothing from the other three; validate.mjs may import money.mjs; pricing.mjs may import money.mjs and validate.mjs; report.mjs may import money.mjs, validate.mjs and pricing.mjs. No module imports src/orderkit.mjs. No import cycles.
- Keep src/orderkit.mjs as the entry file for existing callers. After the change it must contain only export ... from statements (and comments), and it must export exactly the same 49 names it exports today, no more and no fewer, each one the same function or value as in its new module.
- The settings (currency and rounding mode), the tax rate cache and the coupon registry are shared state. After the split there must still be exactly one copy of each, so that configure() called through any path is seen by every module, and resetAll() still resets all three.
- Each of the four new files must be shorter than 300 lines.
- Do not edit test/orderkit.test.mjs. All 40 tests in it must still pass with `npm test`. Additional tests will import the new module paths directly.
- Keep the JSDoc comment on every function when you move it.
